description: This source file defines the final class UserProfileFileFilter which extends javax.swing.filechooser.FileFilter. It provides a specific file filter for 'ECU Logger User Profiles' files with the extension 'xml' for use in a Java GUI, facilitating user profile file selection within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: UserProfileFileFilter
classes.description: A final class extending FileFilter, providing custom filtering for ECU logger user profile XML files within the RomRaider project.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether the specified File is accepted by this filter, delegating to the GenericFileFilter instance.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the human-readable description of files accepted by this filter, delegating to the GenericFileFilter instance.
